name: interview-layout
title: Interview layout
description: A Q&A article with questions set apart from answers, a sticky guest card and room for pull quotes between exchanges.
docs: Pass the guest (a name, role, portrait, a line about them and links) and the exchanges. Each exchange is one item of an ordered list with the question as a heading, so a reader can jump from question to question; answer is a string (one paragraph), an array (one paragraph each) or your own markup, and quote is a string attributed to the guest or an object that names another speaker. The guest card is sticky beside the questions from 1024px (set --sticky-top to the height of your sticky header) and sits above the first question on a phone. title, eyebrow, intro, interviewer, date and readingTime make up the header, and children follows the last answer. Pass labels to translate the fixed words.
